The '''in-patient bay''' was a small area designated for the treatment and recovery of patients at the [[Anglebay Station]] medical center, which was located on [[Telos IV]]. Several of these bays were located in one of the wings of the center. Anglebay Station was [[Attack on Anglebay Station|destroyed]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]].
